create_BraxAgent: create a BraxAgent instance with a make_env_fn and make_env_args to wrap a brax environment
run_BraxAgent_forward: run the BraxAgent forward pass at timestep t to step the environment and collect observations
seed_BraxAgent: seed the BraxAgent with a random seed before initializing environments for reproducibility
create_NoAutoResetBraxAgent: create a NoAutoResetBraxAgent that composes BraxAgent with EpisodesDone to disable auto-reset behavior
review_EpisodesDone: review the EpisodesDone agent that propagates done flags forward across all future timesteps
